Detailed analysis of the second threshold war and hybrid war against China

Link(not secure): 
https://t.co/L2mcNzPuBN

Date: 2025-11-29

This is the eve of a storm, an era in which no one can remain uninvolved. The form of war is no longer as clearly defined as in our parents' memories. It is no longer always accompanied by deafening cannon fire and explicit declarations of war, but has transformed into a silent undercurrent, seeping into every vein of the nation's body, eroding the foundations of social consensus. While we are still gazing into the distance wondering if the smoke of traditional hot war will rise again, a more brutal and complex "secondary threshold war" and "hybrid war" have already fully unfolded around us. This is no longer a prophecy, but a reality we must confront daily. The storm is brewing, and the wind has been blowing for a long time, carrying a chilling cold and an aura of destruction.

Written before a possible third world war? Are they all preparing for war?!

The threshold war and hybrid war have begun—countries around the world are intensifying their preparations before World War III...

In today's world, war has long since moved beyond traditional gunfights. A pervasive, albeit undeclared, "second-threshold war" and "hybrid war" has quietly begun. "Second-threshold" refers to attacks that, while not meeting the criteria for "war" under international law, are sufficient to cause systemic damage to a nation's politics, economy, society, and even ideology. These forms include, but are not limited to: manipulating public ideology, espionage, political interference, sabotage, assassination and poisoning, election manipulation, disinformation campaigns, intellectual property theft, biological warfare, pharmaceutical colonization, market monopolies, color revolutions, instigating ethnic conflict, supporting proxy wars, confiscating or evaporating overseas assets, terrorist attacks disguised as accidents, and latent sabotage tactics. These methods are covert and deadly, often difficult to attribute directly to a single nation, yet capable of silently tearing apart its very foundations.

Hybrid warfare goes a step further, combining kinetic military operations with sub-threshold attacks to form a multi-dimensional strike system. In hybrid warfare, the enemy is no longer confined to the battlefield but infiltrates every corner of society. Advanced technology has made cyberspace and outer space new battlefields. State and non-state actors are increasingly aggressively employing sub-threshold tactics to seek strategic advantage.

For China, this war is no longer a "future tense," but an "ongoing" one. From the "accidental" deaths of key technology experts to the mysterious evaporation of overseas assets; from the undercurrents in the South China Sea to the looming shadow over the Taiwan Strait; from the instigation of separatist forces in Xinjiang and Tibet to the sparks of riots in Hong Kong—all are microcosms of this war.

nd what we face is a vast and cunning enemy camp: NATO's ambitions for eastward expansion, the military encirclement by the US, Japan, and Austria, India's territorial ambitions, the Philippines' role as a pawn, the frantic cries of "fighting to the last soldier" within Taiwan, the long-range warfare trap in the Venezuelan crisis, the resurgence of the Afghan predicament, the attempt to control the Panama Canal… all of this points to a clear signal…

Chapter 1: The Full-Scale Infiltration of the Invisible Front—The Shadow of the Sub-Threshold War

The brilliance of a "secondary threshold" attack lies in its skirting the edge of the legal definition of war. It is a poisoned dagger concealed within a silk glove, striking with deafening force in silence.

First, there is the targeted purge of knowledge and elites. We are heartbroken to see core experts in China's key technology fields repeatedly suffer "accidents." Is this a coincidence? Each fall represents the loss of a pillar of the nation, a stumble in the nation's progress. Essentially, this is an undeclared massacre targeting the pinnacle of Chinese wisdom. It is more precise and more vicious than any missile. And when Israeli warplanes directly intruded into Iranian airspace, killing a nuclear physicist in the street, we should be even more alarmed: this blatant act of state terrorism, if not for Iran's strategic restraint, would essentially constitute a hot war. It is testing, provoking, and drawing a more ambiguous, more favorable red line for all potential adversaries.

Secondly, there is the systemic erosion of the economic foundation. Market monopoly and dumping wars, cloaked in the guise of "free competition," are in reality aimed at strangling our national industries. Backed by massive amounts of capital (even the vast amounts of printed money), they are building high barriers, engaging in devastating price wars, or ruthlessly draining China's resources in the sectors upon which we depend for survival—from grain seeds to key medicines, from core software to industrial machine tools. Their aim is to make us dependent on these vital sectors, ultimately turning us into economic vassals. This is a form of "medical colonialism" and "technological strangulation," which, without firing a single shot, can slowly cause a great nation to collapse in pain and suffocation. Even worse, they have long coveted the overseas assets painstakingly accumulated by the Chinese people, gradually eroding them like a frog being slowly boiled in water, either openly confiscating them under the guise of "law" or quietly "evaporating" them through financial means. This robbery is systematically and systematically robbing our nation of its wealth and weakening our confidence in facing future storms.

Thirdly, there is the erosion of social consensus and the struggle for cognitive domains. Color revolutions are no longer distant legends; their scripts are being meticulously rewritten, attempting to be reenacted on our land. Through ubiquitous internet platforms, they collaborate with corrupt officials within the system to fabricate various unfair and unjust events, sowing the seeds of feminism, effeminate men, Western worship, anti-traditional Chinese medicine, anti-Western pseudo-historical theories, and various forms of Western dross. Simultaneously, they are waging a cognitive war according to Western intentions, sowing discord, creating antagonism, and attempting to tear apart the united body of our nation, even brewing the seeds of "civil war." They use historical nihilism as a weapon to deconstruct our heroes, stigmatize our traditions, and leave the younger generation spiritually adrift. This "war in the cognitive domain" is fought in the minds of everyone, and its outcome concerns the soul and future of a nation.

Fourthly, there is the shadow of biological warfare and new forms of terrorism. It's unclear when it started, but food safety across the entire supply chain is now riddled with hidden dangers; those sudden, unexplained viruses; those pre-prepared Western medicines; those industrial disasters and traffic accidents disguised as accidents; those resurrected, deeply buried "destructive Trojans"... all of these could be disguised terrorist attacks. They are difficult to attribute, yet they can silently and slowly erode the health and lives of the entire population, or cause massive social panic and economic stagnation. When the mainstream population suffers from various diseases, when the number of sudden deaths increases, when the population continues to decline, when Boeing repeatedly experiences inexplicable air crashes, when multiple super fires occur simultaneously in various locations, when a city is paralyzed by an "accidental" biochemical leak, when critical infrastructure collapses due to cyberattacks by "criminal gangs," the real masterminds are lurking in the shadows, coldly admiring their "masterpieces."

The insidious nature of all this lies in the fact that, due to the highly covert methods employed and the frequent reliance on insiders, proxies, hackers, NGOs, or private companies as intermediaries, these attacks are often difficult to pinpoint as the true perpetrators, and may even be protected by powerful shields. We know who the adversary is, yet we often struggle to find that crucial, publicly available evidence—the "last straw." This is the carefully crafted "shield of ambiguity" they have created for themselves.

Chapter Two: A Geopolitical Dilemma Surrounded by Enemies on All Sides—The Iron Wall Encirclement in Hybrid Warfare

As the slow poison of "secondary threshold" continues to be injected, the kinetic iron fist of "hybrid warfare" has also been raised high. This is a meticulously planned, multi-dimensional geostrategic encirclement aimed at trapping China in its near seas and disintegrating it in its surrounding areas.

In the East, the Taiwan Strait has become the most dangerous powder keg. Within Taiwan, the US and Japan have cultivated deep roots for decades, relentlessly instilling the poison of "resisting China and protecting Taiwan," arming every pawn on the island. Their sinister intention is to "fight to the last Taiwanese," using the blood of their compatriots to pull chestnuts out of the fire for them. If the situation changes drastically, we will face not only compatriots across the sea, but also a massive, deeply brainwashed "proxy army" of millions, completely and forcibly obeying the West under the supervision of a US-Japan-Western coalition. Meanwhile, the US-Japan-Australia military alliance is conducting exercises in the Asia-Pacific region with unprecedented frequency, its operational intent self-evident—to intervene in the Taiwan Strait, distorting China's just war to safeguard national unity into a regional war against the entire Western military system. Japan, a country that has never thoroughly settled its historical accounts, is seeing the lingering specter of its militarism resurface amidst the incense offerings at the Yasukuni Shrine. Its 2025 Defense White Paper explicitly lists China as the primary threat and vows to build the capability to respond to "hybrid warfare" by fiscal year 2027. The refusal of Sanae Takaichi's team to retract their harsh statement that "if Taiwan is in danger, Japan is in danger," coupled with the accelerated deregulation by right-wing forces and the large-scale production and stockpiling of nuclear weapons materials, reveals their wolfish ambitions.

In the south, beneath the surface of the South China Sea, turbulent undercurrents surge. The Philippines, once a friendly neighbor, has now become a strategic pawn of the United States. Its repeated provocations in places like Ren'ai Reef and Huangyan Island are not isolated incidents, but a typical manifestation of the US's "leveraging its strengths" strategy—using an insignificant pawn to exhaust our strategic energy, smear China in international public opinion, and find a pretext for a larger-scale military presence.

India, harboring its long-held dream of a "Greater Indian Federation," continues to encroach on its borders, its territorial ambitions never extinguished. It serves as both a powerful southern anchor for the West to contain China and a regional power with imperial ambitions, always ready to seize opportunities on China's flank. Furthermore, the emergence of the K visa seems tailor-made for the large-scale influx of Indians into China. Indian domestic discourse is rife with tactical guides on how to exploit loopholes in Chinese policies to harm China and enrich India.

Along the China-Myanmar border, and even extending to Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand, the telecom fraud and parts swapping industry chain, which operates both internally and externally, has been repeatedly cracked down on, but it continues to harm Chinese people on a large scale in cooperation with Chinese insiders.

In the West, a grand strategy of "creative destruction" is being laid out. Attacking Russia is never the ultimate goal. Western strategists are keenly aware that a strong and stable strategic partnership with China and Russia is the most solid obstacle on their path to hegemony. Therefore, the Ukrainian battlefield is both a quagmire to wear down Russia and a "rehearsal" against China. Their ultimate objective is to use Russia as a springboard; once this polar bear is dismembered or tamed, its vast territory and resources can serve as a forward base, directly threatening China's heartland from the north by land. Simultaneously, they are eagerly seeking a "return to Afghanistan," attempting to reignite the flames of war in this "graveyard of empires," endlessly harassing and encircling us from China's western backyard. The Silk Road, traversing Central Asia, is facing the danger of being severed once again.

On the distant other side, Venezuela is becoming another point of contention. Why is the United States so fixated on this Latin American country? One of the underlying logics is to open a second front there, forcing China into an extremely unfavorable situation of "long-range warfare." If the United States were to take military action against Venezuela, would China intervene or not? If it intervenes, it would be a long-distance expedition, exposing its supply lines to the enemy's full threat, with little chance of victory; if it doesn't intervene, its strategic credibility would be ruined, and its global partners would be disheartened. This is a meticulously designed strategic trap.

At crucial junctures of global trade, a tight net is tightening. The Panama Canal, the Suez Canal, the Strait of Malacca… these vital arteries of world trade are firmly controlled by Western navies. They don't need to wage war; simply conducting inspections, blockades, or shipping controls under the guise of "maintaining navigational safety" or "imposing sanctions" during a "crisis" is enough to strangle the lifeline of the Chinese economy. Merchant ships at sea are blocked, land routes are fraught with danger, and coupled with a "technological iron curtain" aimed at locking up China's future, a vast encirclement of China, encompassing land, sea, and technology, is essentially taking shape.

Chapter Three: Alliances and the Documents Reveal – The Enemy Has Bared Its Fangs

The enemy has never concealed their intentions. A review of the latest official strategic documents released by the United States, Japan, Britain, France, and other countries reveals a strong sense of impending war, with their plans for the war timetable evolving from vague warnings to concrete countdowns.

Japan's 2025 Defense White Paper, a meticulously crafted 546-page document, reveals its ambitions. It explicitly declares that "a serious event similar to Russia's invasion of Ukraine, which could shake the foundations of the international order, cannot be ruled out, especially in East Asia," and sets a target of having the capability to "deter or repel an invasion with the support of allies" by fiscal year 2027. It places China at the core of the threat narrative and is also deeply concerned about Russia's militarization of the "Northern Territories." This document is an unmistakable declaration of preparedness, and its target of 2027 coincides closely with the risks we face in the Taiwan Strait and other regions.

France's "National Strategic Assessment 2025" is deeply imprinted with the fear of war with Russia. It states bluntly that "we are entering a new era: by 2030, the risk of a high-intensity, large-scale war on European soil is particularly prominent." It details Russia's "hybrid warfare" tactics—cyberattacks, election manipulation, the persecution of exiled dissidents, and the creation of divisions within society. The document calls for "society-wide mobilization" and "moral rearmament" in France, with the goal of "containing its adversaries, especially Russia," by 2030. While the document attempts to reassure itself that war will not reach French soil, its 2030 deadline is closely synchronized with the pace of the global arms race.

The UK's Strategic Review 2025 begins by defining "second-threshold attacks" and "hybrid warfare," indicating that the UK itself will actively utilize these methods. It defines Russia as a "direct and imminent threat," while China is a "complex and persistent challenge." This document reveals the UK's continued ambition to see itself as a global power and envisions transforming its defense into a "leading, technologically advanced defense power" by 2035. Its defense spending plan is also progressively ambitious, increasing from the current 2.3% to 2.5% by 2027, and further to 3% after 2030. This is a longer-term roadmap aimed at reshaping the global military power landscape.

A comprehensive analysis of these theoretical documents reveals a clear conclusion: the United States, Japan, France, and the United Kingdom—former empires and now core allies of the US—are all preparing for a nationwide war in preparation for an inevitable great power conflict. While their respective timelines for completing these preparations (2027, 2030, 2035) are based more on realistic considerations of their own economic capacity than on precise war predictions, this precisely demonstrates that war preparations have entered a substantial, budget-driven national trajectory. Together, they paint a terrifying picture of a world order undergoing a final, decisive clash between 2027 and 2035.

Chapter Four: The Ultimate Showdown – The Dimensional Reduction Strike of Thermonuclear Warfare and Robotic Warfare

We must be soberly aware that any future global war will never be a simple repetition of 20th-century conflicts. It will be a high-tech war combining thermonuclear warfare and robotics, an ultimate showdown pursuing "dimensional reduction strikes."

Technological leaps have created new paths and spaces for warfare. Cyberspace and outer space have become the fourth and fifth dimensions of battlefields, following sea, land, and air. Here, a meticulously planned cyberattack can completely paralyze a city's power system; an anti-satellite test can render a modern army relying on GPS/BeiDou/Galileo navigation blind. States and non-state actors are increasingly aggressively using these threshold actions to gain an advantage.

The ultimate shadow of great power conflict is nuclear weapons. Russia, China, the United States, the United Kingdom, and France—all nuclear powers—place nuclear weapons at the core of their security strategies and are accelerating the modernization and expansion of their arsenals. A British document incisively points out: "Countries like Russia intentionally blur the lines between nuclear, conventional, and sub-threshold threats, making it more difficult for the UK and its allies to deal with potential escalation and miscalculation." This "nuclear coercion" will be a core challenge for decades to come. Their operational strategies are based on the assumption of threatening "limited use" of tactical nuclear weapons to end conflict under favorable conditions. This drastically lowers the nuclear threshold, keeping the world constantly on the brink of nuclear catastrophe.

Meanwhile, disruptive technologies such as artificial intelligence, autonomous unmanned systems (robots), and hypersonic weapons are shaping new forms of warfare. The protagonists of future battlefields may no longer be organized units of soldiers, but rather swarms of drones, unmanned surface vessels operating in the deep sea, and tireless robotic warriors. Whoever masters these technologies will be able to achieve a "dimensional reduction strike" against the enemy at the start of the war—like a modern army versus a tribe armed with cold weapons, the outcome is predetermined before the battle even begins. This forces China to participate in this high-tech military race that will determine its national destiny, regardless of the cost.

The cyclical nature of history, like the Sword of Damocles, hangs over all of humanity. Both World War I and World War II stemmed from cyclical economic crises that the capitalist world could not resolve on its own, reaching a deadlock. Each major war, through physical "creative destruction," forcibly shattered the old economic order and overcapacity, allowing the world to rebuild from the ruins and escape the economic deadlock. Currently, global economic difficulties, massive financial bubbles, debt crises, industrial hollowing out, and unequal distribution are pushing the world towards a similar, or even more severe, "economic deadlock." This will inevitably force certain powers to once again resort to war as the "ultimate solution." This is not a matter of morality, but a cold, "rational" choice based on capitalist logic—a total genocide and reshaping of order to create absolute commercial advantage. This is already a mature formula for vying for global hegemony, tried twice, and therefore, there will be a third time. This is extremely "logical and rational," and therefore extremely dangerous.

Epilogue: A period of great change, a great clash, a great shock—we have nowhere to retreat.

A storm begins with a ripple, and a wave begins with a gentle ripple. Everything we are witnessing today—from the unexpected strangeness of experts to the evaporation of overseas assets; from the rampant pro-independence forces in Taiwan to the farce of the South China Sea arbitration; from NATO's eastward expansion to the layered encirclement of the Indo-Pacific strategy; from the cold dates in the strategic documents of various countries to the ceaseless roar of the arms industry—is not an isolated event.

These are different facets of the same war. A world war called "sub-threshold" and "hybrid" has already begun, albeit imperceptibly. It has no unified start time, no clear battle lines, but it is real and is sliding at an alarming speed towards the critical point of kinetic conflict. China is facing unprecedented changes in a century, and is also encountering unprecedented challenges. Each of us is living in an era of yet another great transformation, on the eve of a great collision, at the epicenter of a great shock.

We cannot place our hopes on the enemy's mercy, nor can we underestimate their cunning. From the Taiwan Strait to the South China Sea, from the border regions to the interior, from the internet to outer space, the smoke of war has quietly permeated every corner. Retreat will not bring peace, but only more complete destruction. Illusions cannot save the nation, only lead to utter ruin. The torrent of history rolls ever onward; those who follow it prosper, those who oppose it perish. In this ultimate showdown that will determine the fate of the nation and the future of humanity, we must recognize the situation, abandon illusions, and prepare for struggle. We must unite the will and strength of the entire nation, with unparalleled resilience, extraordinary wisdom, and decisive courage, to meet the open and covert attacks from all sides. Only through nationwide awakening, comprehensive preparedness, and a full-scale counterattack can we stand firm in this "great transformation, great clash, and great impact."

The bells of history are tolling, and the shadow of World War III looms large. China must be fully prepared!

This is a war we must win. Because we have no way to retreat. Victory is the only way out.

This is a meticulously designed strategic trap. At crucial junctures of global trade, a tight net is tightening. This document is an unmistakable declaration of preparedness, and its target of 2027 coincides closely with the risks we face in the Taiwan Strait and other regions. It states bluntly that "we are entering a new era: by 2030, the risk of a high-intensity, large-scale war on European soil is particularly prominent." While the document attempts to reassure itself that war will not reach French soil, its 2030 deadline is closely synchronized with the pace of the global arms race.
